title: Surreal Clockwork Dreamscape
description: A vibrant surreal scene depicts a skeletal grim reaper in a purple robe with gears and clocks, holding a large ornate clock face with a green winged elephant emerging from it. Below, a witch on a broomstick flies through a swirling vortex of hot air balloons, pocket watches, stars, and geometric patterns under a radiant sun with a cosmic colorful sky.
prompt: Highly detailed surreal fantasy scene with a skeletal grim reaper in flowing purple robes and gears, tongue out, holding a large golden clock from which a cute green winged elephant with blue head emerges, a witch with long white hair in a teal dress and pointed hat flying on a broomstick with magic sparkles, swirling vortex of colorful hot air balloons shaped like clocks, floating pocket watches, stars, geometric triangles, radiant sun with rays in a psychedelic purple green and orange cosmic sky, intricate details, vibrant colors
